title: Extremal Graphs for the Lights Out Problem
summary: Lights Out is a game played on a graph $G$ where every vertex has a light bulb that is either on or off, and pressing a vertex $v$ toggles the state of every vertex in the closed neighborhood of $v$. The goal is to find a subset of vertices $S$ such that pressing every vertex in $S$ results in all light bulbs being turned off. We study the extremal graphs for which pressing every vertex is the unique solution to the lights out problem given an initial configuration of all lights on.
